compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The header surface is operator-facing and security-sensitive, and its value grammar
(`${env:...}`, `${run:...}`) is rebar-specific. `docs/config.md` and `docs/llm-framework.md`
document every other LLM knob, including the `LANGFUSE_*` sink at
`docs/llm-framework.md:433`; without an entry an operator cannot discover the feature, and
without security guidance they are likely to place a gateway credential in a committed file.

## Approach

Document the knob where the other LLM knobs already live, rather than in a new page: an
operator looking for LLM configuration reads these two files.

Add to `docs/config.md` the `llm.headers` key, its three resolution layers and precedence,
the `${env:...}` and `${run:...}` grammar with the closed `${run:...}` vocabulary, and the
rejected header names.

Add to `docs/llm-framework.md` a gateway-observability recipe showing at least two different
gateways, so no vendor reads as the supported one. Include the caveat that nginx strips
header names containing underscores by default, which is why a gateway's underscore-form
header may silently never arrive.

State the security guidance explicitly: values may reference environment variables so a
credential need not be committed; authentication header names are rejected because caller
headers are merged last by the vendor SDKs and would displace the real credential; and
header values are recorded nowhere, only names.

## Scope

- `docs/config.md` — the `llm.headers` key, layers, grammar and rejected names.
- `docs/llm-framework.md` — the gateway recipe, the nginx caveat, the security guidance.

## Testing

No `## Testing` section beyond this note: the change adds no executable behavior. Its
acceptance is verified by the documentation-parity assertions below, which are grep-shaped
checks over the committed files rather than behavioral tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/config.md` documents `llm.headers`, its three layers with precedence, and the
      closed `${run:...}` vocabulary; checked by reading the rendered section and by a grep
      asserting each of `trace_id`, `ticket_id`, `operation` appears in it.
- [ ] `docs/config.md` lists every rejected header name; checked by a grep asserting all five
      of `authorization`, `x-api-key`, `cookie`, `host`, `proxy-authorization` appear.
- [ ] `docs/llm-framework.md` shows the recipe for at least two distinct gateways; checked by
      a grep asserting two different gateway header prefixes appear in the section.
- [ ] The nginx underscore-stripping caveat is stated; checked by a grep for "underscore" in
      the new section.
- [ ] The security guidance states that values may use `${env:...}`, that authentication
      header names are rejected, and that values are never recorded; checked by reading the
      rendered section against those three points.
